vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Terminology}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

| Term              | Meaning                                                           |
|-------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| ROS model version | The schema and table definitions for a ROS database version.      |
| Metadata snapshot | The editable CSV files extracted from PostgreSQL.                 |
| Database comment  | A description stored in PostgreSQL on a schema, table, or column. |
| Report domain     | The schemas selected for ALL or one gear.                         |
| Dependency        | The foreign key from a table to a referenced table.               |
| Usage             | The same foreign key viewed from the referenced table.            |
| Dependency graph  | An interactive view of tables and their foreign keys.             |
